When Apollo came back, the two had settled their differences and were simply talking as they It the forge. “Is it true that in Estland their monarch has banned magic?” Lance sighed and rested his arm on the stone slab behind him. “Yes, they believe magic has connections to the bestial race.” Grynnan shifted her attention on the boy, and immediately a smile covered her face. “You look different, but in a nice day. Your curls look bouncier somehow.” She glided a hand through his hair, chuckling at his happy expression.
Apollo smiled as the exited the shop, chuckling at how adorable Grynnan is. After cutting his hair with a small blade, he found the length satisfying. He then soon returned. Apollo smiled as he heard Grynnan’s compliment, leaning into her touch softly. “Thank you, Dearest..~ It does seem to be a lot better than before..~” He said be he sat next to her, looking at Lance. “So what’s this about Estland..?” He was in a curious tone. His voice had gotten a bit more serious due to his father being a big person in that region. He didn’t like it, but he still wanted to have some update on what his father is doing or about to do.
“Estleners being deranged, as per usual.” Chuckled Grynnan. Lance sighed and put his hands over his arms, being an Estlener himself, he felt a little embarrassed for the trouble his country caused. “They believe beasts are so inferior, that they have banned the only connection man has with beast.” The two quickly brushed over the subject, as they did not enjoy talking about gloom all that much. “So, are you ready to go?” The larger woman asked as she got up from her seat, she was a little worried about going out, but as long as she was with Apollo she knew she would be okay. She ran her claws through her own hair and let out a loud puff, her crocodile-like whacking side to side. “We should go now, before it becomes midday.. That is the busiest time for the inn.”
Apollo would huff softly, crossing his arms as they spoke of his homeland, not wanting to be in gloom much longer. “Let’s just hope they don’t invade this town..” he said with a nervous laugh before smiling up at Grynnan, gently holding her large hand. “Of course! Let’s go!” He said enthusiastically before dragging Grynnan outside, it being hard since he’s small compared to her.
